title: Config
line: What boots a world: its name, seed, start, apps, actors and rules. pace and front are for doors, never for apps.

pace.line: World milliseconds a door adds to each act; none means the wall clock.

front.line: Paths a door shows on the front page, each read as the one who looks.

items.line: An app id, or { id, config } where config reaches that app's boot.

actors.line: Who may act; none means anyone.

rules.line: Knobs as app.knob: value. Boot checks each against its app's schema and fills the rest from reality. { pick: [...] } draws one by the seed.
